content.short: Ethernal is an open-source block explorer for EVM-based chains.
content.description: Ethernal is a block explorer for EVM-based chains that provides a UI on top of local nodes for solo developers (e.g., Hardhat, Ganache). It also serves teams needing a block explorer for their shared hosted node, protocols that require an explorer for their users, and developers who spin up short-lived explorers linked to CI environments to debug tests. Beyond blocks and transactions, Ethernal offers a UI to interact with contracts, decode internal transactions, reveal internal contract storage, display network stats, and showcase NFT galleries to help users understand their chain.
